parent: u01 (unloading_the_car) / c01 (loading_the_car): localisation, map, routes, arm planner
summary: First controller for put_together_a_basic_pruning_kit. The toolbox, the pruner and the shears are found on the garage floor from the head camera's depth image (groups of points above free floor, told apart by height and size); which long side of the toolbox is its front is read from the colour image (two black latches). For each tool the stance at the toolbox is chosen first, and with it the hand that opens the lid there; the tool goes into the other hand (where either hand can open the box, into the one that has the sound way onto the pruner): the shears at their middle, where the blades cross, from straight above; the pruner by its pair of handles with a slanted hand that comes along the pair from the end its blades lean away from (a pruner that has been knocked over, from above: across its handles if it lies flat, across its 3 cm if it lies on a narrow side). At the box one hand takes the lid's handle from above, a little to the hinge side of its middle, and leads the lid up along an arc worked out from where the hand has it; the other hand comes over the open box from above and lets the tool go, the second tool into the other half of the box; the lid is led back: let go 0.2 rad from shut after the first tool, shut by the hand after the second. The base stands at the box's hinge side or at an end, or at its front where a wall leaves no other room, the lid then led less far.
